title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: Fisheries ministers exchanged views on the vision 2040 for fisheries and aquaculture. They also discussed fishing opportunities for 2027 in the Atlantic and North Sea, as well as in the Mediterranean and Black Seas, following a presentation by the Commission of its two proposals. As far as agriculture is concerned, the Council discussed the market situation, a recurring item on the agenda of the Council following Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: The Council agreed its partial negotiating position on the regulation for the post-2027 common agricultural policy in the context of the negotiations for the EU’s next long-term budget. Ministers also discussed trade-related agricultural issues. As far as fisheries is concerned, the Council reached a political agreement on the fishing opportunities in the Baltic Sea for 2027, and prepared the ground for the EU’s position for the annual meeting of the International Commission for the Conservation of Atlantic Tunas (ICCAT).

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: The Council today reached a partial negotiating mandate on the regulation setting out the post-2027 EU support for the fisheries sector. Among other topics, ministers also discussed the proposal for a regulation amending the European Maritime, Fisheries and Aquaculture Fund.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: The Irish presidency presented their work programme and main priorities in the agriculture and fisheries sectors. Ministers exchanged views on the Commission’s livestock strategy and protein plan, on trade-related agricultural issues, and held a discussion focusing on the role of women in agriculture.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: During the first day of the Agriculture and Fisheries Council, ministers discussed the evaluation of the common fisheries policy regulation. They also talked about the Commission’s communication on sustainable fishing in the EU: state of play and orientations for 2027.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: Ministers exchanged views on the availability and affordability of fertilisers in the EU and on the Commission’s fertiliser action plan. They also discussed trade-related agricultural issues.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: Ministers exchanged views on the post-2027 CAP proposals focused on income support, role of agriculture and forest management in preventing wildfires, and on the current market situation.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: Ministers exchanged views on the Vision for Agriculture and Food, trade-related agricultural issues, and on energy transition in the EU fisheries and aquaculture sectors.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: Ministers exchanged views on the post-2027 common agricultural policy national recommendations and on the evaluation report on the unfair trading practices directive.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: After the presentation of the Cyprus Presidency programme, the Council discussed the EU updated Bioeconomy Strategy and the proposal to amend the Organic farming Regulation.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: Ministers reached a political agreement on the proposals on fishing opportunities in the Atlantic and the North Sea for 2026, 2027 and 2028, and on fishing opportunities in the Mediterranean and Black Seas for 2026.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description:
Ministers had a thematic discussion on the CAP post-2027, focusing on food security and targeting of support as well as crisis preparedness and reserves. There also discussed trade-related agricultural issues, including closer relations between the EU and Ukraine.
On fisheries, ministers exchanged views on the Commission’s proposals for fishing opportunities in the Atlantic and the North Sea, and in the Mediterranean and Black Seas and highlighted their countries’ priorities.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description:
During the first day of the meeting, EU agriculture and fisheries ministers discussed the 2026 fishing opportunities in the Baltic Sea and exchanged views on the upcoming meeting of the International Commission for the Conservation of Atlantic Tunas (ICCAT).
As far as agriculture was concerned, the ministers discussed the post-2027 CAP proposals in relation to the green architecture, and also the market situation, particularly in the context of Russia's war of aggression against Ukraine.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: EU agriculture ministers discussed trade-related agricultural issues and addressed a number of 'other business' items during the second day of their September meeting. In particular, the Council received information from the Commission on the European water resilience strategy.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: The Danish presidency presented its work programme and priorities for the second semester of the year. The Council also exchanged views on the market situation for agricultural products and commodities, as well as on the supply, production and sustainability of proteins.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: The Council reached its position on a new EU-wide forest monitoring framework. Fisheries ministers discussed the state of play of sustainable fishing in the EU, and took note of the progress made on the animal transport and plant reproductive material proposals. During their two-day meeting, agriculture ministers also discussed trade-related agricultural issues and held a policy debate on a proposal for simplification in agriculture.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: The Council held a discussion on the vision for agriculture and food, welcoming the vision's emphasis on the need for dialogue with farmers. Ministers also took stock of the latest developments on agricultural markets. Furthermore, the Council received information on a number of 'other business' points, notably the simplification package for the agricultural sector.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: The Council held a policy debate on the European Commission's vision for agriculture and food. Over the course of an informal lunch, fisheries ministers discussed the future of the common fisheries policy. The Council also dealt with a number of 'other business' points.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: Agriculture ministers discussed the situation of agricultural markets and commodities and exchanged views on the principle of rural proofing. The Commission presented its vision on agriculture and food.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: The Council discussed the simplification of the CAP and exchanged views on trade-related agricultural issues and on two regulations aimed at strengthening the position of farmers in the food supply chain. The Polish presidency also presented its priorities for the next six months.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: During the second day of the meeting, the Council reached a political agreement on fishing opportunities in the Atlantic, the North Sea, the Mediterranean and the Black Seas for 2025.The Council also discussed the progress made during the Hungarian presidency on several legislative files, i.e. the proposals on plant reproductive material, on forest reproductive material and on the protection of animals during transport.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description:
During today's meeting, the Agriculture and Fisheries Council welcomed the Ukrainian Minister for Agrarian Policy and Food, Vitalii Koval, who presented information about the situation of the agricultural sector in Ukraine to his European counterparts. In the ensuing EU internal discussion, the Council took stock of the EU markets situation for agrifood products.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description:
The Agriculture and Fisheries Council met in Luxembourg on 21-22 October 2024.
Fisheries ministers discussed fishing opportunities in the Baltic Sea, reaching a political agreement on catch limits for 2025. Additionally, they also exchanged views on the upcoming meeting of the International Commission for the Conservation of Atlantic Tunas (ICCAT).
As far as agriculture is concerned, the Council took stock of the main challenges that the EU food chain is facing, and discussed trade-related agricultural issues, as well as the future CAP post-2027.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description:
Agriculture ministers assessed the second year of implementation of the strategic plans of the common agricultural policy, in order to identify possible improvements for the post-2027 period. The Council also discussed the situation of agricultural markets and commodities, based on information provided by the member states and an update from the Commission. Furthermore, during an informal lunch discussion, ministers exchanged views on the strategic dialogue on the future of EU agriculture.

title: Informal meeting of agriculture and fisheries ministers
Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description:
The Agriculture and Fisheries Council met on Monday, 15 July 2024.
The Hungarian presidency presented its work programme for the coming semester, outlining its main priorities in the field of agriculture and fisheries.
The Council also held a targeted discussion on ways to improve the long-term viability of rural areas, with a focus on generational renewal and demographic aspects.
Additionally, ministers discussed trade-related agricultural issues and recent developments.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description:
The Agriculture and Fisheries Council exchanged views on sustainable fishing in the EU and the main orientations for the fishing opportunities for 2025. During this discussion, ministers expressed their views on their main priorities for this year's exercise of setting fishing opportunities for 2025.
Furthermore, the Belgian presidency updated the Council on the state of play of some current legislative proposals (forest monitoring framework, plant reproductive material, forest reproductive material, animal protection during transport).

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: The Agriculture and Fisheries Council met on Monday 27 May 2024 in Brussels. Agriculture ministers discussed the current crisis situation in the agricultural sector. The Council also exchanged views on the market situation, in particular following the invasion of Ukraine.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: Agriculture ministers met in Luxembourg to discuss the responses to the current situation in the agricultural sector, based on information from the European Commission. They also exchanged views on trade-related agricultural issues, as well as the member states’ annual performance reports under the common agricultural policy. During an informal lunch, they discussed the strategic dialogue for the future of agriculture.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description:
The Agriculture and Fisheries Council discussed the EU's response to the current concerns in the agricultural sector. The Council welcomed the recent initiatives and proposals made by the Commission and provided further political guidance on the next steps to be taken. Agriculture ministers also welcomed the approval by the Special Committee on Agriculture of the text of the proposal to amend certain parts of the CAP which will allow greater flexibility for complying with certain environmental and other requirements.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description:
Against the backdrop of ongoing farmers' protests and based on information from the Belgian presidency and a non-paper on simplification prepared by the European Commission, during February's Council meeting, agriculture ministers discussed the current crisis and challenges in the sector.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: During the first Agriculture and Fisheries Council held under the Belgian presidency, ministers discussed trade-related agricultural issues and held an exchange of views on a proposal for a forest monitoring framework. Additionally, based on information from the Commission, the Council discussed the strategic dialogue on the future of agriculture.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description:
Fisheries ministers reached a political agreement on the proposal for fishing opportunities in the Atlantic and the North Sea for 2024 and, in the case of some stocks, also for 2025 and 2026, as well as on the proposal concerning fishing opportunities in the Mediterranean and the Black Sea for 2024.

The Council also discussed the market situation and exchanged views on the first year of implementation of the CAP strategic plans.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description:
Today, EU agriculture and fisheries ministers met in Brussels and approved Council conclusions on a long-term vision for the EU's rural areas. The conclusions provide political guidance to the Commission and member states on their future actions in support of these areas, which cover more than 80% of the EU's territory.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: Agriculture and fisheries ministers met in Luxembourg and discussed Baltic Sea fisheries for 2024, reaching a political agreement during the second day of the Council meeting. They also discussed the upcoming ICCAT annual meeting, and the market situation. Before their discussion on the market situation, ministers welcomed the Ukrainian Minister for Agrarian Policy and Food, who addressed the Council. Among other topics, ministers also discussed the food-related aspects of the waste framework directive.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: Ministers focused on the agricultural aspects of the directive on soil health, agricultural issues related to trade, including linked to the latest developments related to Russia's war against Ukraine, the long-term vision for the EU's rural areas, as well as annual fisheries consultations for 2024.

title: Agriculture and Fisheries Council
description: Agriculture and fisheries ministers met in Brussels on 25 July. They heard from the Spanish presidency regarding its priorities and work programme for agriculture and fisheries this semester, and discussed the market situation in light of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine. Ministers also exchanged views on the Commission’s study complementing the impact assessment of the proposal for a regulation on the sustainable use of pesticides, and on the recent proposal on new genomic techniques.
